data.desc: 3 E Network Technology Group Limited is a business-to-business ('B2B') information technology ('IT') business solutions provider committed to becoming a next-generation artificial intelligence ('AI') infrastructure solutions provider. It upholds the industry consensus of 'AI and energy symbiosis' and has a strong vision in the field of energy investment. The Company's business comprises two main portfolios: the data center operation services portfolio and the software development portfolio.
